title.zh-CN: 反复腹胀伴恶心 · 69岁女性
title.en: Recurrent abdominal distension and nausea · 69-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 69岁女性，反复腹胀、恶心一个月后住院：在病房问诊查体，一步步查清肝脏的问题，决定怎样安全地取得诊断，并为她此后的日子做计划。
summary.en: A 69-year-old woman is admitted after a month of recurrent bloating and nausea: assess her on the ward, work out what is happening in her liver step by step, decide how to reach a diagnosis safely and plan the days that follow.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——69岁女性，反复腹胀伴恶心 1 个月，无发热、皮肤发黄和腹痛，既往无恶性肿瘤病史；入院查体肝下缘在剑突下约 5 cm、质硬、表面不光滑、有压痛；CA125 38.10 U/mL、CA19-9 68.60 U/mL 升高，CEA、AFP、CA15-3、CA72-4 正常；超声示肝内多发不均匀实性肿块（最大约 12.0×10.5 cm）；18F-FDG PET/CT 示多发不均匀高摄取病灶（SUVmax 7.1，最大约 11.2×10.6×7.9 cm，中心摄取稀疏），考虑恶性肿瘤伴瘤内出血及肝内转移；肝右叶肿物穿刺病理为血管肉瘤；数日后因肝内出血死亡——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除。分阶段设计（入院时在病房问诊、查体并完成超声和肿瘤标志物；进一步影像后决定穿刺；病理结果后制定计划；最后查阅结局）、多期增强 CT/MRI、血常规和凝血等今日应做而原报告未记录结果的检查、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色及患者说出的担忧均为教学设计，不增加临床事实；未记录的内容（生命体征、血常规、凝血、肝肾功能、肝炎病毒学、用药与抗栓药、过敏、职业暴露、穿刺方式、出血的经过与抢救、免疫组化）保持未知。1.0.0 版中几处表述差异（PET/CT 结论的中英文措辞、“数日后”的起算点、超声和肿瘤标志物相对 PET/CT 的时间）保留并列入导师指南的待核实清单。获准展示的两幅原图（超声、组织病理）只在结局阶段出现。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 69-year-old woman with a month of recurrent abdominal distension and nausea, without fever, jaundice or abdominal pain and with no history of malignancy; on admission a liver edge about 5 cm below the xiphoid, hard, irregular and tender; CA125 38.10 U/mL and CA19-9 68.60 U/mL raised, CEA, AFP, CA15-3 and CA72-4 normal; an ultrasound with multiple heterogeneous solid liver masses (the largest about 12.0 × 10.5 cm); an 18F-FDG PET/CT with multiple heterogeneous FDG-avid lesions (SUVmax 7.1; the largest about 11.2 × 10.6 × 7.9 cm with low central uptake) read as a malignant tumour with intratumoural haemorrhage and intrahepatic spread; a needle biopsy of a right-lobe mass showing angiosarcoma; death from intrahepatic haemorrhage a few days later — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed. The staging (history, examination, ultrasound and tumour markers on the ward on admission; further imaging, then the biopsy decision; planning after the histology; the recorded outcome last), the tests a clinician would order today whose results the report does not record (multiphase CT or MRI, blood count, clotting and others), decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worry are teaching design that adds no clinical fact; what is not recorded (vital signs, blood count, clotting, liver and renal function, hepatitis serology, medicines and antithrombotics, allergies, exposures, how the biopsy was done, the course of the bleeding and any resuscitation, immunohistochemistry) stays unknown. Points where the 1.0.0 text differs with itself (the wording of the PET/CT conclusion in the two languages, the starting point of “a few days later”, the timing of the ultrasound and markers relative to the PET/CT) are kept and listed in the facilitator guide's “To verify”. The two approved figures (ultrasound, histology) appear only in the outcome phase.

disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded vital signs, test results and responses to treatment are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对质硬、表面不平的肝大伴肝内多发肿块，能开出并说明检查路径：腹部超声，血常规、凝血、肝功能和肝炎病毒学，并在任何穿刺之前完成多期增强 CT 或 MRI。
learningOutcomes.en: Order and justify the work-up of a hard, irregular hepatomegaly with multiple liver masses: abdominal ultrasound, blood count, clotting, liver tests and hepatitis serology, and multiphase contrast CT or MRI before any biopsy.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在各自的局限内解读肿瘤标志物和 FDG PET/CT：AFP 正常不能排除恶性，CA125、CA19-9 升高不能定位原发灶，FDG 摄取不能确定组织学类型。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret tumour markers and FDG-PET/CT within their limits: a normal AFP does not exclude malignancy, raised CA125 and CA19-9 do not locate a primary, and FDG uptake does not establish the histology.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把肝占位穿刺当作高出血风险操作来计划：先明确血小板、凝血和抗栓药，影像引导下经正常肝组织穿刺活跃的肿瘤，备血，术后观察，介入科待命。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan a liver-lesion biopsy as a high-bleeding-risk procedure: platelets, clotting and antithrombotics known first, image guidance through normal liver into viable tumour, blood available, observation afterwards and interventional radiology ready.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明多灶性肝血管肉瘤的处理要点：在已有组织上做免疫组化、转介肉瘤专科团队、全身治疗或最佳支持治疗，以及为什么手术切除和肝移植不可行。
learningOutcomes.en: Outline the management of multifocal hepatic angiosarcoma: immunohistochemistry on the existing core, referral to a sarcoma team, systemic therapy or best supportive care, and why resection and transplantation are not options.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 预判肿瘤出血：选择机械性而不是药物性血栓预防，并与患者本人商定以介入栓塞为核心的出血预案和治疗限度。
learningOutcomes.en: Anticipate tumour haemorrhage: choose mechanical rather than drug VTE prophylaxis, and agree with the patient an embolisation-based bleeding plan and the limits of treatment.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 讨论穿刺后发生的死亡时，区分时间先后和因果证据，不断言未经证实的原因。
learningOutcomes.en: Discuss a death that follows a biopsy without asserting an unproven cause, keeping the temporal sequence apart from the evidence.

personality.en: A 69-year-old woman admitted to the ward with a month of recurrent bloating and nausea. Gentle and orderly in how she speaks and keen to help, but privately afraid of what the tests may show. She says only what she knows; when she doesn't know, she says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.en: Plain everyday words in short sentences; no medical terms.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我这肚子老是胀，还恶心，反反复复的，有一个月了。
openingLine.en: Doctor, my tummy keeps getting bloated and I feel sick. It keeps coming back — it's been a month now.

fallbackUnknown.zh-CN: 这个我真说不上来，医生。

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：她半卧在病床上，说话清楚，有点紧张。只说病史里有的内容：肚子胀、恶心一个月，反反复复；没有发烧、没有发黄、肚子不疼；以前没得过癌。不说任何检查数字或结果，不编造用药、抗栓药、过敏、饮酒、职业、体重或家族史——问到时就说说不上来。病理结果出来后，她想听直白的话，想知道接下来怎么办。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: she is propped up in bed, speaks clearly and is a little anxious. She says only what her history holds: a month of bloating and nausea that keeps coming back; no fever, no yellowing, no tummy pain; never had cancer. She never gives test numbers or results and never invents medicines, blood thinners, allergies, drinking, work, weight or family history — asked, she says she cannot say. Once the biopsy result is back she wants plain words and to know what happens next.

name.zh-CN: 影像引导下肝占位粗针穿刺活检
name.en: Image-guided core biopsy of a liver mass

dose.zh-CN: 超声（或 CT）引导、同轴技术：经正常肝组织穿刺病灶活跃的边缘，取多条粗针组织（16–18 G），避开中心出血坏死区和包膜下穿刺；术前明确血小板和凝血（INR）、停用抗栓药并备血；术后卧床观察至少 3 小时，介入科待命。
dose.en: Ultrasound (or CT) guidance with a coaxial technique: through normal liver into the viable edge of a lesion, several 16–18 G cores, avoiding the haemorrhagic, necrotic centre and a subcapsular approach; platelets and clotting (INR) known, antithrombotics held and blood grouped first; at least 3 hours of observation afterwards, with interventional radiology on call.

harm.zh-CN: 现在不能这样做。肝穿刺属于高出血风险操作（SIR 2019：INR ≤ 1.5–1.8、血小板 ≥ 50×10⁹/L），《原发性肝癌诊疗指南（2024年版）》要求穿刺前检查血小板和出凝血功能；BSG 2020 要求先复核影像、规划穿刺路径。在还没有看过进一步影像的结果、或者还不知道血常规和凝血结果的时候，穿刺一个 12 cm 的不均匀肿块，可能引发无法控制的出血。
harm.en: Not like this. A liver biopsy is a high-bleeding-risk procedure (SIR 2019: INR ≤ 1.5–1.8, platelets ≥ 50 × 10⁹/L); the 2024 Chinese primary liver cancer guideline requires the platelet count and clotting before a liver lesion is sampled, and BSG 2020 asks for the imaging to be reviewed and the route planned first. Sampling a 12 cm heterogeneous mass before the further imaging has been read, or before the blood count and clotting are known, risks a bleed that cannot be controlled.

response.zh-CN: 肝右叶肿块的穿刺组织已送病理。本病例没有记录穿刺路径、针型和穿刺后的情况；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Tissue from the right-lobe mass is sent for histopathology. This case does not record the route, the needle or how she was after the biopsy; nothing is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 再次经皮肝穿刺（另取一个病灶）
name.en: Repeat percutaneous liver biopsy of another lesion

dose.zh-CN: 超声引导下经皮穿刺另一个肝内病灶，为免疫组化取新鲜组织。
dose.en: Ultrasound-guided percutaneous biopsy of a second liver lesion, for fresh tissue for immunohistochemistry.

harm.zh-CN: 没有必要，而且危险：穿刺一旦得出病理诊断，免疫组化就在同一块组织上做。再一次穿刺这些不均匀的肝内肿块（最大约 12 cm），会增加可能无法控制的出血风险，却不会改变处理。《原发性肝癌诊疗指南（2024年版）》在取材过少、或病理结果与临床的高度怀疑不符时才考虑重复穿刺，而不是为了补做染色。
harm.en: Unnecessary and dangerous: once a biopsy has given the diagnosis, immunostains are done on that same block. Another needle pass into these heterogeneous liver masses (the largest about 12 cm) adds the risk of a haemorrhage that may not be controllable, for no change in management. The 2024 Chinese primary liver cancer guideline considers a repeat liver biopsy when the sample is too small or the result conflicts with a strong clinical suspicion — not to add stains.

name.zh-CN: 依诺肝素预防剂量皮下注射，每日一次（药物性血栓预防）
name.en: Prophylactic-dose enoxaparin SC once daily (drug thromboprophylaxis)

dose.zh-CN: 依诺肝素预防剂量，皮下注射，每日一次。
dose.en: Enoxaparin at the prophylactic dose, SC, once daily.

harm.zh-CN: 现在不适合她。NICE NG89（2018，2019 更新）要求先权衡血栓风险和出血风险，再决定是否药物预防。她的血小板和凝血还不清楚，肝穿刺即将进行或刚刚做过（BSG 2020：预防剂量低分子肝素须在穿刺前 12 小时停用），肝内的肿块还可能出血：改用机械性预防（ASH 2018：出血风险不可接受时），并每天重新评估。
harm.en: Not for her now. NICE NG89 (2018, updated 2019) asks for her VTE risk to be weighed against her bleeding risk before any drug prophylaxis. Her platelet count and clotting are unknown, a liver biopsy is coming or has just been done (BSG 2020 stops prophylactic LMWH 12 hours before it), and the liver masses may bleed: use mechanical prophylaxis (ASH 2018: when the bleeding risk is unacceptable) and reassess daily.

name.zh-CN: 活检前输注新鲜冰冻血浆
name.en: Fresh frozen plasma before the biopsy

dose.zh-CN: 活检前静脉输注新鲜冰冻血浆，预防出血。
dose.en: Fresh frozen plasma IV before the biopsy, as prophylaxis against bleeding.

harm.zh-CN: 没有指征：BSG 2020 建议 INR ≤ 2.0 时不要用新鲜冰冻血浆纠正后再做肝穿刺，SIR 2019 也只在测得的 INR 超过阈值时才纠正。她的 INR 还没有测，盲目输注血浆只带来输血反应、容量负荷过重等风险，没有证实的获益：先检测。
harm.en: Not indicated: BSG 2020 recommends against using FFP to correct an INR ≤ 2.0 before a liver biopsy, and SIR 2019 corrects only a measured INR above its threshold. Her INR has not been measured; plasma given blind brings the risks of transfusion — reactions, volume overload — for no proven benefit. Measure first.

name.zh-CN: 转诊肝移植评估
name.en: Refer for liver transplant assessment

dose.zh-CN: 联系肝移植中心，评估她是否适合肝移植。
dose.en: Contact the transplant centre to assess her for liver transplantation.

harm.zh-CN: 这不是可选的方案：欧洲肝移植登记（2013）中，因肝血管肉瘤接受肝移植的患者平均生存约 7 个月，无一人超过 23 个月，多数死于复发，该登记因此将其视为肝移植的绝对禁忌。转诊只会带来虚假的希望，并耽误她真正需要的计划。
harm.en: Not an option: in the European Liver Transplant Registry (2013), patients transplanted for hepatic angiosarcoma survived about 7 months on average, none beyond 23 months, most dying of recurrence, and the registry calls it an absolute contraindication. The referral raises false hope and delays the plan she needs.

name.zh-CN: 提交肝胆肿瘤多学科讨论（MDT）
name.en: Present her at the hepatobiliary tumour board (MDT)

dose.zh-CN: 提交肝病科、肝胆外科、介入放射科、肿瘤科、影像科和病理科的多学科讨论：影像结论、是否穿刺及如何穿刺、出血预案。
dose.en: Present her to the hepatology, hepatobiliary surgery, interventional radiology, oncology, radiology and pathology team: the imaging, whether and how to biopsy, and the plan if she bleeds.

response.zh-CN: 她已列入多学科讨论。本病例没有记录是否进行过这样的讨论；不模拟其效果。
response.en: She is listed for the multidisciplinary meeting. This case does not record whether such a discussion took place; nothing is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 通知介入放射科：一旦出血，紧急血管造影和栓塞
name.en: Alert interventional radiology: urgent angiography and embolisation if she bleeds

dose.zh-CN: 电话通知介入放射科：说明 PET/CT 提示瘤内出血、肝穿刺已计划或刚完成；一旦出现腹痛或疼痛加重、心率加快、血压或血红蛋白下降，立即复苏、交叉配血，并行急诊血管造影和经导管动脉栓塞。
dose.en: Phone interventional radiology: the PET/CT read bleeding inside the tumour and a liver biopsy is planned or done; if she develops abdominal pain or it worsens, her pulse rises or her blood pressure or haemoglobin falls, resuscitate, cross-match and proceed to urgent angiography and transarterial embolisation.

response.zh-CN: 介入放射科已知情并同意预案。本病例没有记录当时是否有这样的预案；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Interventional radiology knows and has agreed the plan. This case does not record whether such a plan existed; nothing is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 穿刺后观察：生命体征、腹痛和血红蛋白
name.en: Post-biopsy observation: vital signs, pain and haemoglobin

dose.en: Bed rest and observation for at least 3 hours after the biopsy, and longer here as malignancy is strongly suspected: pulse, blood pressure and pain at the intervals the local protocol sets, and an urgent haemoglobin if anything changes.
dose.zh-CN: 穿刺后卧床观察至少 3 小时；高度怀疑恶性，观察时间应更长：按本院流程定时测脉搏、血压和疼痛评分，有变化时急查血红蛋白。

response.zh-CN: 观察已开始。本病例没有记录穿刺后的生命体征或血红蛋白；不模拟其变化。
response.en: Observation is under way. This case records no vital signs or haemoglobin after the biopsy; nothing is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 机械性血栓预防（间歇充气加压装置）
name.en: Mechanical VTE prophylaxis (intermittent pneumatic compression)

dose.zh-CN: 无禁忌时双下肢使用间歇充气加压装置；鼓励活动、保持液体平衡；每天重新评估血栓和出血风险。
dose.en: Intermittent pneumatic compression to both legs if there is no contraindication; encourage mobility and hydration; reassess VTE and bleeding risk daily.

response.zh-CN: 加压装置已戴上。本病例没有记录血栓预防措施；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The compression devices are fitted. This case does not record any VTE prophylaxis; nothing is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 转介肿瘤专科团队（肿瘤内科）
name.en: Refer to the specialist oncology team (medical oncology)

dose.zh-CN: 转介与这种肿瘤类型相应的肿瘤专科团队，带上病理、PET/CT 和她本人的意愿，评估体能状态、肝功能和全身治疗的可能。
dose.en: Refer to the specialist oncology team for this tumour type, with the histology, the PET/CT and her own wishes, to assess her performance status, liver function and the options for systemic therapy.

response.zh-CN: 肿瘤专科团队已收到转介。本病例没有记录肿瘤科的评估或任何治疗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The oncology team has the referral. This case does not record any oncology review or treatment; nothing is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 转介姑息治疗团队
name.en: Refer to the palliative care team

dose.zh-CN: 请姑息治疗团队一起处理腹胀和恶心等症状，并参与预先照护计划。
dose.en: Ask the palliative care team to help with her bloating and nausea and with advance care planning.

response.zh-CN: 姑息治疗团队会来看她。本病例没有记录姑息治疗的介入；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The palliative care team will see her. This case does not record any palliative care input; nothing is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 与她本人谈诊断、预后和治疗限度（含抢救意愿）
name.en: Talk with her about the diagnosis, the outlook and the limits of treatment, including resuscitation

dose.zh-CN: 在安静的房间按 SPIKES 进行：先了解她已经知道什么、想知道多少，再用通俗的话说明诊断、出血的风险和可选的方案；询问她最看重什么，商定治疗限度和抢救意愿并记录；她愿意时请家属一起参与。
dose.en: In a quiet room, using SPIKES: find out what she already knows and how much she wants to know; explain the diagnosis, the bleeding risk and the options in plain words; ask what matters most to her; agree the limits of treatment and her wishes about resuscitation, and record them; involve her family if she wishes.

response.zh-CN: 谈话已进行并记录。本病例没有记录她被告知了什么、她有什么意愿；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The conversation is held and recorded. This case does not record what she was told or what she wished; nothing is simulated.

hint.zh-CN: 问清她哪里不舒服、多长时间、是怎样发作的，有哪些、没有哪些其他症状，以前有没有得过癌。
hint.en: Ask what has been troubling her, for how long and in what pattern, which other symptoms she has or has not had, and whether she has ever had cancer.

guidance.en: Take the history from her at the bedside.

title.en: Examine her and get the first tests

hint.zh-CN: 她肝脏的大小、质地和表面提示什么？哪项一线检查能看到肝脏？无论结果如何，你都需要哪些血液检查？肿瘤标志物能告诉你什么、不能告诉你什么？
hint.en: What do the size, consistency and surface of her liver suggest? Which first-line test images the liver, which blood tests will you need whatever it shows, and what can tumour markers tell you — and not tell you?

guidance.zh-CN: 检查腹部，完成超声和抽血检查，然后在会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Examine her abdomen, get the ultrasound and the blood tests, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

hint.zh-CN: FDG 摄取反映的是什么，又不能告诉你什么？大肿块中心摄取稀疏可能意味着什么？这对下一步为什么重要？
hint.en: What does FDG uptake measure, and what can it not tell you? What might low uptake in the centre of a large mass mean, and why does that matter for what you do next?

guidance.zh-CN: 安排影像检查，查看报告，并作答决策 2。
guidance.en: Arrange the imaging, read its report and answer decision 2.

hint.zh-CN: 在穿刺这个肝脏之前，你必须先知道她血液和用药的哪些情况？穿哪个病灶的哪个部位、走什么路径？万一出血，需要事先准备好什么？
hint.en: What must you know about her blood and her medicines before a needle goes into this liver? Which part of which lesion would you sample, by what route, and what must be ready if it bleeds?

guidance.zh-CN: 作答决策 3，完成必要的检查，然后安排穿刺。
guidance.en: Answer decision 3, complete the checks you need and arrange the biopsy.

title.zh-CN: 制定穿刺后的诊疗计划
title.en: Plan her care after the biopsy

hint.zh-CN: 病理结果改变了什么、没有改变什么？可以提供什么、不能提供什么？应该请哪些人参与？怎样让她本人和团队为出血风险做好准备？
hint.en: What does the histology change, and what does it not? What can and cannot be offered, who should be involved, and how will you prepare her and the team for the risk of bleeding?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅病理报告，做出相应处理，并作答决策 4 和 5。
guidance.en: Read the histology report at the nurses' station, act on it and answer decisions 4 and 5.

title.zh-CN: 对照她此后的实际经过
title.en: Compare your plan with what happened

hint.zh-CN: 记录的经过能告诉你什么、不能告诉你什么？单凭事情的先后顺序，能说明什么导致了什么吗？
hint.en: What does the recorded course tell you, and what can it not? Can the order of events alone show what caused what?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅之后记录的经过。
guidance.en: Read the recorded course at the nurses' station.

prompt.zh-CN: 严女士，69岁，反复腹胀伴恶心 1 个月，无发热、皮肤发黄和腹痛，既往无恶性肿瘤病史。查体：肝下缘在剑突下约 5 cm，质硬、表面不光滑、有压痛。超声：肝内多发不均匀实性肿块，最大约 12.0×10.5 cm，考虑恶性。肿瘤标志物：CA125 38.10 U/mL、CA19-9 68.60 U/mL 升高；CEA、AFP、CA15-3、CA72-4 正常。下一步最合适的是什么？
prompt.en: Ms Yan, 69, has had a month of recurrent abdominal distension and nausea without fever, jaundice or abdominal pain, and has no history of cancer. Her liver edge is about 5 cm below the xiphoid, and the liver is hard, irregular and tender. Ultrasound: multiple heterogeneous solid liver masses, the largest about 12.0 × 10.5 cm, suspicious for malignancy. Tumour markers: CA125 38.10 U/mL and CA19-9 68.60 U/mL raised; CEA, AFP, CA15-3 and CA72-4 normal. What is the best next step?

need.zh-CN: 请先问清她的病史、检查她的肝脏，并查看腹部超声和肿瘤标志物结果。
need.en: First take her history, examine her liver and read the ultrasound and tumour-marker results.

text.zh-CN: 先做多期增强 CT 或 MRI 和分期检查，同时查血常规、凝血和肝功能，再计划是否穿刺
text.en: Multiphase contrast CT or MRI and staging, with blood count, clotting and liver tests, before any biopsy is planned

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ACG 2024 建议对性质不明的肝占位做多期增强 CT 或 MRI（动脉晚期、门静脉期、延迟期）：它能显示血供特点、有无出血和病灶数目，并决定是否穿刺、穿哪里、怎样穿。分期检查寻找肝外病变（FDG PET/CT 可以帮助，原报告团队就用了它）。任何穿刺之前都需要血常规、凝血和肝功能（SIR 2019；BSG 2020）。
feedback.en: Correct. ACG 2024 recommends multiphasic contrast-enhanced CT or MRI (late arterial, portal venous and delayed phases) for any liver lesion of uncertain cause: it shows the vascular pattern, any haemorrhage and the number of lesions, and decides whether, where and how to sample. Staging looks for disease elsewhere (FDG-PET/CT can help, and the report's team used it). The blood count, clotting and liver tests are needed before any biopsy (SIR 2019; BSG 2020).

text.zh-CN: 今天就在病房超声引导下穿刺 12 cm 的最大肿块，因为无论之后影像如何，终究都需要组织诊断
text.en: Ultrasound-guided core biopsy of the 12 cm mass on the ward today, since tissue will be needed whatever further imaging shows

feedback.zh-CN: 还不行。最终很可能需要组织诊断，但在断层影像之前穿刺一个 12 cm 的不均匀肿块，就不知道它的血供、有没有出过血、哪部分是有活性的肿瘤，而且她的血小板和凝血都还不清楚。BSG 2020 和《原发性肝癌诊疗指南（2024年版）》要求先复核影像、检查血小板和凝血；ACG 2024 建议对性质不明的肝占位先做多期增强 CT 或 MRI。
feedback.en: Not yet. Tissue will probably be needed, but sampling a 12 cm heterogeneous mass before cross-sectional imaging means not knowing its blood supply, whether it has bled or which part is viable — and her platelet count and clotting are unknown. BSG 2020 and the 2024 Chinese primary liver cancer guideline ask for the imaging to be reviewed and platelets and clotting checked first, and ACG 2024 recommends multiphasic CT or MRI for a liver lesion of uncertain cause.

text.zh-CN: 按 CA125 和 CA19-9 升高判断为卵巢或胰腺来源的转移，不再做影像，直接转肿瘤科化疗
text.en: Treat the raised CA125 and CA19-9 as pointing to an ovarian or pancreatic primary and refer for chemotherapy without further imaging

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。CA125 和 CA19-9 都没有特异性：许多癌症（包括肝脏和胆道的肿瘤）以及一些良性情况都会使其升高，它们都不能确定原发部位。没有组织诊断就化疗，等于凭猜测治疗。应先明确肿块性质并取得病理（ACG 2024）。
feedback.en: No. CA125 and CA19-9 are non-specific: both rise with many cancers, among them liver and bile-duct tumours, and in benign conditions, and neither identifies a primary site. Chemotherapy without a tissue diagnosis treats a guess. Characterise the masses and obtain histology first (ACG 2024).

text.zh-CN: AFP 正常，肝脏恶性肿瘤的可能性不大，3 个月后复查超声，看肿块是否增大
text.en: With a normal AFP a malignant liver tumour is unlikely, so repeat the ultrasound in three months to see whether the masses grow

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。AFP 正常不能排除恶性：一部分肝细胞癌 AFP 并不升高（2024 年版中国指南为 AFP 阴性肝癌列出了其他标志物），其他大多数肝脏肿瘤也不升高 AFP。肝脏质硬、表面不平，多发不均匀实性肿块最大 12 cm，需要尽快明确性质，而不是等 3 个月（ACG 2024）。
feedback.en: No. A normal AFP does not exclude malignancy: it is normal in a share of hepatocellular carcinomas (the 2024 Chinese guideline lists other markers for AFP-negative disease) and in most other liver tumours. A hard, irregular liver with multiple heterogeneous solid masses up to 12 cm needs prompt characterisation, not a three-month wait (ACG 2024).

text.zh-CN: 按多发肝脓肿处理：抽血培养、静脉用抗生素，并先经皮引流最大的肿块
text.en: Treat them as multiple liver abscesses with blood cultures, intravenous antibiotics and percutaneous drainage of the largest mass first

feedback.zh-CN: 可能性不大。她没有发热，超声描述的是实性肿块而不是积液。引流一个实性、可能富血供的肿瘤容易出血，也得不到诊断；应先做多期增强 CT 或 MRI 明确性质（ACG 2024）。
feedback.en: Unlikely. She has no fever, and the ultrasound describes solid masses rather than collections. Draining a solid, possibly vascular tumour invites bleeding and gives no diagnosis; characterise the masses with multiphase CT or MRI first (ACG 2024).

prompt.zh-CN: 18F-FDG PET/CT：肝内多发不均匀 FDG 摄取病灶，SUVmax 7.1；最大者约 11.2×10.6×7.9 cm，中心摄取稀疏，报告考虑恶性肿瘤伴瘤内出血及肝内转移。这项检查能确立什么？
prompt.en: 18F-FDG PET/CT: multiple heterogeneous FDG-avid liver lesions, SUVmax 7.1; the largest is about 11.2 × 10.6 × 7.9 cm with low uptake in its centre, which the report reads as a malignant tumour with intratumoural haemorrhage and intrahepatic spread. What does this scan establish?

need.zh-CN: 请先完成并查看进一步的影像检查。
need.en: First get and read the further imaging.

text.zh-CN: 很可能是代谢活跃、瘤内已有出血的恶性肿瘤；PET/CT 不能确定类型，仍需组织诊断
text.en: Probably a metabolically active malignant tumour that has bled inside; the scan cannot name its type, so tissue is still needed

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。FDG 摄取反映的是葡萄糖代谢，而不是组织学：癌、肉瘤、淋巴瘤和部分感染都可以高摄取，所以这项检查支持恶性、显示病变范围，但不能分型。《原发性肝癌诊疗指南（2024年版）》用 PET/CT 做分期，影像不典型的肝占位则靠穿刺活检明确诊断。报告考虑瘤内出血，这一点对下一步很重要：说明这是一个脆弱、富血供的肿瘤。
feedback.en: Correct. FDG uptake measures glucose metabolism, not histology: carcinomas, sarcomas, lymphomas and some infections can all be FDG-avid, so the scan supports malignancy and maps its extent but cannot type it. The 2024 Chinese guideline uses PET/CT for staging and turns to biopsy for a liver lesion without typical imaging features. The reading of haemorrhage inside the tumour matters for the next step: it marks a fragile, vascular tumour.

text.zh-CN: SUVmax 7.1 加中心摄取缺损已可确诊原发性肝癌，不必穿刺即可开始治疗
text.en: An SUVmax of 7.1 with a cold centre is diagnostic of a primary liver cancer, so treatment can start without a biopsy

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。没有哪个 SUV 数值能对应某种肿瘤类型，癌、肉瘤和淋巴瘤的摄取互相重叠；中心摄取缺损只说明中央没有代谢，这里报告考虑的是瘤内出血。没有病理就治疗，可能用错方案；诊断要靠影像之后的粗针穿刺（2024 年版中国指南）。
feedback.en: No. No SUV value is specific to a tumour type: uptake overlaps across carcinomas, sarcomas and lymphomas, and a cold centre only says the middle is not metabolising — and here the report reads haemorrhage within the tumour. Treating without histology risks the wrong treatment; the diagnosis rests on core biopsy after imaging (2024 Chinese guideline).

text.zh-CN: AFP 正常而 FDG 摄取很高，可以排除肝细胞癌，所以一定是其他部位原发灶的肝转移
text.en: A normal AFP together with strong FDG uptake excludes hepatocellular carcinoma, so these must be metastases from a primary elsewhere

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。部分肝细胞癌 AFP 正常，FDG 摄取高低也既不能确诊、也不能排除肝细胞癌。这两项检查在这里都排除不了任何诊断，只有组织能回答（《原发性肝癌诊疗指南（2024年版）》：影像不典型的肝占位应穿刺活检）。
feedback.en: No. AFP is normal in a share of hepatocellular carcinomas, and FDG uptake neither confirms nor excludes HCC. Neither test excludes anything here; only tissue can (2024 Chinese primary liver cancer guideline: biopsy for liver lesions without typical imaging features).

text.zh-CN: 最大病灶中心摄取稀疏是坏死的脓腔，应在其他处理之前先行引流
text.en: The cold centre of the largest lesion is a necrotic abscess cavity that should be drained before anything else is done

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她没有发热；大肿瘤中心摄取稀疏通常代表坏死或出血，报告考虑的是瘤内出血。引流一个富血供的肿瘤只会招致更多出血，也仍然得不到诊断；ACG 2024 要求的是明确性质、必要时取组织，而不是引流。
feedback.en: No. She has no fever, and low central uptake in a large tumour usually means necrosis or haemorrhage, and the report reads haemorrhage within the tumour. Draining a vascular tumour invites more bleeding and still gives no diagnosis; ACG 2024 asks for characterisation and, where needed, tissue — not drainage.

prompt.zh-CN: 团队一致认为需要组织病理诊断。应当怎样取得？
prompt.en: The team agrees that a tissue diagnosis is needed. How should it be obtained?

need.zh-CN: 请先解读进一步的影像（决策 2）。

text.zh-CN: 影像引导下经正常肝组织穿刺病灶活跃的边缘，术前查血小板、凝血和抗栓药并备血
text.en: Image-guided core biopsy of a lesion's viable edge through normal liver, after platelets, clotting and blood thinners are checked and blood is grouped

feedback.en: Correct. BSG 2020: image guidance for every focal lesion, an 18 G core for a solid lesion, an INR below 2.0 for a lesional biopsy and at least 3 hours of observation — longer when malignancy is strongly suspected, as its authors' 2020 amendment advises. SIR 2019 classes it as high bleeding risk (INR ≤ 1.5–1.8, platelets ≥ 50 × 10⁹/L). The 2024 Chinese guideline asks for platelets and clotting first, 18 G or 16 G cores and a route through normal liver to the active tumour. With bleeding already read inside the tumour, have blood and interventional radiology ready.
feedback.zh-CN: 正确。BSG 2020：局灶病变一律影像引导，实性病灶用 18 G 粗针，病灶穿刺要求 INR < 2.0，术后至少观察 3 小时；按其作者 2020 年的修订，高度怀疑恶性时应考虑延长观察。SIR 2019 把它列为高出血风险操作（INR ≤ 1.5–1.8，血小板 ≥ 50×10⁹/L）。《原发性肝癌诊疗指南（2024年版）》要求先查血小板和凝血，用 18 G 或 16 G 空芯针，穿刺路径经过正常肝组织、取影像上活跃的肿瘤。影像已提示瘤内出血，要备好血，并让介入科待命。

text.zh-CN: 超声引导下细针抽吸最大肿块中心摄取稀疏处做细胞学检查，因为瘤体中央的细胞最能反映肿瘤类型
text.en: Fine-needle aspiration of the low-uptake centre of the largest mass under ultrasound, because cytology from the middle of a tumour shows its type most reliably

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。最大肿块中心摄取稀疏、没有代谢活性，PET/CT 又考虑瘤内出血，从那里抽到的多半是血和坏死物，单靠细胞学也常常无法给肿瘤分型。BSG 2020 对实性病灶用 18 G 粗针取组织；2024 年版中国指南用 18 G 或 16 G 空芯针，穿刺影像上活跃的肿瘤部分。
feedback.en: No. The cold centre of the largest mass is not metabolically active, and the PET/CT reads haemorrhage within the tumour: an aspirate from there is likely to be blood and necrotic debris, and cytology alone often cannot type the tumour. BSG 2020 takes an 18 G core from a solid lesion, and the 2024 Chinese guideline takes 18 G or 16 G cores from the active tumour seen on imaging.

text.zh-CN: 在床旁经可触及的肝下缘直接穿刺，不用影像引导，因为肝脏这么大一定能穿到肿瘤
text.en: Percutaneous biopsy at the bedside through the palpable liver edge without imaging, as a liver this large cannot be missed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。BSG 2020 建议局灶病变一律在影像引导下穿刺。盲穿既选不到有活性的肿瘤，也避不开中心出血区和大血管，何况她的凝血还不清楚。
feedback.en: No. BSG 2020 recommends image guidance for every focal lesion. A blind pass cannot choose viable tumour or avoid the haemorrhagic centre and large vessels, and her clotting is still unknown.

text.zh-CN: 今天就对最大的肿块粗针穿刺，不等血常规和凝血结果，因为延误一个很可能是癌的诊断风险更大
text.en: Core biopsy of the largest mass today without waiting for the blood count and clotting, because delaying the diagnosis of a probable cancer is the greater risk

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。肝穿刺属于高出血风险操作（SIR 2019），2024 年版中国指南要求穿刺肝占位前检查血小板和凝血；肿瘤已经出过血，风险更高。等几个小时的结果代价很小，没有准备的穿刺却可能引发无人应对的大出血。
feedback.en: No. A liver biopsy is a high-bleeding-risk procedure (SIR 2019), and the 2024 Chinese guideline requires platelets and clotting before a liver lesion is sampled; a tumour that has already bled raises the stakes. Waiting a few hours for results costs little; an unprepared biopsy can end in a haemorrhage no one is ready for.

prompt.zh-CN: 肝右叶穿刺病理：血管肉瘤；没有记录免疫组化结果。PET/CT 显示肝内多发病灶并肝内转移。下一步的总体方案以哪项最合适？
prompt.en: Histology of the right-lobe needle biopsy: angiosarcoma; no immunohistochemistry results are recorded. The PET/CT showed multiple liver lesions with intrahepatic spread. What is the best overall plan?

need.zh-CN: 请先在护士站调阅病理报告。
need.en: First read the histology report at the nurses' station.

text.zh-CN: 在已有组织上补做免疫组化，交肉瘤团队讨论，与她商定：能耐受就全身治疗，否则最佳支持治疗
text.en: Immunostains on the existing core, sarcoma-team review, and a plan made with her: systemic therapy if she is fit enough, otherwise best supportive care

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。免疫组化（如 CD31、CD34、ERG）在已经取到的组织上做。ACG 2024 建议原发性肝血管肉瘤转介肉瘤专科中心，只在可行时手术切除；多发病灶并肝内转移时，ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS 2021 推荐姑息性全身治疗——以蒽环类为标准一线，血管肉瘤也可选择紫杉类 [III, B]。她能否耐受没有记录，所以方案要和她本人一起定。
feedback.en: Correct. Immunohistochemistry (for example CD31, CD34 and ERG) is done on the block already taken. ACG 2024 recommends referring primary hepatic angiosarcoma to a sarcoma centre and resecting only where feasible; with multiple lesions and spread within the liver, ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS 2021 offers palliative systemic therapy — anthracycline-based as the standard first line, with taxanes an option in angiosarcoma [III, B]. Whether she is fit for it is not recorded, so the plan is made with her.

text.zh-CN: 转诊评估肝移植：病变看起来局限在肝内，换一个新肝就能一次去除全部病灶，术后再辅以化疗
text.en: Refer her for liver transplantation, since the disease appears confined to the liver and a new liver would remove every lesion at once, with chemotherapy afterwards

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。肝血管肉瘤是肝移植的绝对禁忌：欧洲肝移植登记（2013）中，移植后平均生存约 7 个月，无一人超过 23 个月，多数死于复发。
feedback.en: No. Hepatic angiosarcoma is an absolute contraindication to liver transplantation: in the European Liver Transplant Registry (2013) mean survival after transplantation was about 7 months, no patient lived beyond 23 months, and most died of recurrence.

text.zh-CN: 先做扩大右半肝切除，切掉最大的那个肿块，等她术后恢复以后，再用化疗处理肝内剩下的小病灶
text.en: An extended right hepatectomy to remove the largest mass, followed by chemotherapy for the smaller lesions left behind in the liver once she has recovered from surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ACG 2024 只在可行时才主张切除；多发病灶并肝内转移，切掉最大的肿块仍会留下病变，而在已经出血的肿瘤上做大范围肝切除手术风险很高，也没有治愈的可能。
feedback.en: No. ACG 2024 favours resection only where it is feasible; with multiple lesions and spread within the liver, removing the largest mass leaves disease behind, and a major hepatectomy through a tumour that has bled carries a high operative risk with no prospect of cure.

text.zh-CN: 先穿刺另一个病灶取新鲜组织做免疫组化，等结果出来之前，不和她本人也不和团队讨论下一步
text.en: Biopsy a second lesion to obtain fresh tissue for immunostains first, and hold any discussion with her or with the team until those results are back

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。这次穿刺已经得出诊断，免疫组化就在这块组织上做。再穿刺一次已经出血的富血供肿瘤只增加出血风险，不会改变方案（2024 年版中国指南在取材过少、或病理与临床的高度怀疑不符时才考虑重复穿刺，这里两者都不是）；拖着不谈，则让她在时间可能不多的时候仍不知情。
feedback.en: No. The biopsy already gives the diagnosis, and immunostains are done on that block. A second pass into a vascular tumour that has bled adds haemorrhage risk without changing the plan (the 2024 Chinese guideline considers a repeat biopsy when the sample is too small or the result conflicts with a strong suspicion — neither applies here), and holding back the conversation leaves her uninformed while time may be short.

prompt.zh-CN: PET/CT 提示瘤内出血，她又刚做过肝穿刺。接下来几天的计划以哪项最合适？
prompt.en: The PET/CT read bleeding inside the tumour, and she has just had a liver biopsy. Which plan for the coming days is best?

need.zh-CN: 请先确定病理之后的总体方案（决策 4）。
need.en: First decide the overall plan after the histology (decision 4).

text.en: Agree a plan now: observations and haemoglobin, blood available, radiology ready to embolise, mechanical VTE prophylaxis, treatment limits agreed with her
text.zh-CN: 现在商定：监测生命体征和血红蛋白、备血、介入栓塞待命、机械性血栓预防、与她谈治疗限度

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。肝血管肉瘤本身就可能出血或破裂，穿刺又增加了风险（2016 年韩国多中心研究：33 例穿刺中 3 例严重出血）。ACG 2024 对肝腺瘤破裂先稳定血流动力学，再行栓塞和/或切除；对出血的多灶性肿瘤，要准备好的是栓塞——在出血发生之前就定好叫谁、做什么。NICE NG89（2018，2019 更新）要求在药物预防之前权衡血栓和出血风险；ASH 2018 建议出血风险不可接受时采用机械性预防——本例正是如此。治疗限度和抢救意愿要用通俗的话与她本人讨论。
feedback.en: Correct. Hepatic angiosarcoma can bleed or rupture on its own, and a biopsy adds a further risk (severe bleeding after 3 of 33 biopsies in a Korean multicentre series, 2016). ACG 2024 manages a ruptured liver adenoma by haemodynamic stabilisation followed by embolisation and/or resection; for a bleeding multifocal tumour, embolisation is the step to have ready — decide who is called and what is done before it happens. NICE NG89 (2018, updated 2019) weighs clots against bleeding before any drug prophylaxis, and ASH 2018 recommends mechanical prophylaxis when the bleeding risk is unacceptable — as here. Limits of treatment and resuscitation are discussed with her, in plain words.

text.zh-CN: 像其他住院肿瘤患者一样开始预防剂量依诺肝素，因为肿瘤和卧床使她的血栓风险高过出血风险
text.en: Start prophylactic-dose enoxaparin as for any inpatient with cancer, because the tumour and bed rest raise her risk of clots more than her risk of bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。NICE NG89（2018，2019 更新）要求在药物预防之前权衡血栓风险和出血风险；肿瘤内已有出血、又刚做过肝穿刺，出血风险占上风。应采用机械性预防（ASH 2018），并每天重新评估。
feedback.en: No. NICE NG89 (2018, updated 2019) asks for her VTE risk to be weighed against her bleeding risk before any drug prophylaxis; with haemorrhage inside the tumour and a fresh liver biopsy, the bleeding risk prevails. Use mechanical prophylaxis (ASH 2018) and reassess each day.

text.zh-CN: 把急诊开腹肝切除作为任何出血的首选处理，并提前预约好手术室，以免到时耽误手术
text.en: Plan emergency laparotomy and liver resection as the first response to any bleed, and book theatre time in advance so that surgery is not delayed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。肝肿瘤出血首先靠复苏和经导管动脉栓塞控制（ACG 2024 对肝腺瘤破裂：先稳定，再栓塞和/或切除）；急诊肝切除去除不了多灶病变，只能是最后的手段，而不是首选方案。
feedback.en: No. Bleeding from a liver tumour is first controlled by resuscitation and transarterial embolisation (ACG 2024, for a ruptured adenoma: stabilisation, then embolisation and/or resection); an emergency resection cannot remove multifocal disease and is a last resort, not the first plan.

text.zh-CN: 和她本人谈话时不提出血和抢救，改为私下和家属商定方案，让她免受这份痛苦
text.en: Leave bleeding and resuscitation out of conversations with her, and settle the plan quietly with her family instead so that she is spared the distress

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。这些决定属于她本人。SPIKES（Baile 2000）先了解她知道什么、想知道多少，再一步步用通俗的话说明；她愿意的话可以请家属参与，但把她排除在外，就是替她做了决定。
feedback.en: No. The decisions are hers. SPIKES (Baile 2000) asks what she knows and how much she wants to know, then gives information in plain steps; her family can join if she wishes, but leaving her out takes the decisions away from her.

text.zh-CN: 问清病史：腹胀伴恶心 1 个月、反复发作，无发热、皮肤发黄和腹痛
text.en: Took the story: a month of bloating and nausea that keeps coming back, with no fever, jaundice or abdominal pain

text.zh-CN: 询问了既往肿瘤、肝病、抗栓药、出血倾向、饮酒和职业暴露
text.en: Asked about earlier cancer, liver disease, blood thinners, bleeding tendency, alcohol and work exposures

text.zh-CN: 检查了肝脏：肝下缘、质地、表面和压痛
text.en: Examined the liver: its edge, consistency, surface and tenderness

text.zh-CN: 完成腹部超声和肿瘤标志物，并送检血常规、凝血、肝功能和肝炎病毒学
text.en: Got the ultrasound and tumour markers, and sent the blood count, clotting, liver tests and hepatitis serology

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择先明确性质和分期、再考虑取材，并及时申请了多期增强 CT 或 MRI
text.en: Chose characterisation and staging before any sampling at the first attempt, and requested multiphase CT or MRI in time

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即在 PET/CT 的局限之内正确解读
text.en: Read the PET/CT within its limits at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即定好取材方案，提交多学科讨论，并及时做了血型鉴定备血
text.en: Planned the sampling at the first attempt, took her to the multidisciplinary meeting and had her blood grouped in time

text.zh-CN: 穿刺时机和准备正确：看过进一步影像之后，并先送检了血常规和凝血
text.en: Took the biopsy at the right time and prepared: after reading the further imaging, with the blood count and clotting sent first

text.zh-CN: 穿刺后安排了观察，并在结局揭晓之前与介入放射科商定了栓塞预案
text.en: Set up observation after the biopsy and agreed an embolisation plan with interventional radiology before the outcome was known

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对病理之后的方案，要求在已有组织上加做免疫组化，并转介肿瘤专科（肉瘤）团队
text.en: Chose the plan after the histology at the first attempt, asked for immunostains on the existing core and referred her to the specialist (sarcoma) oncology team

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对接下来几天的计划，并采用机械性而非药物性血栓预防
text.en: Chose the plan for the coming days at the first attempt and fitted mechanical rather than drug VTE prophylaxis

text.zh-CN: 在结局揭晓之前，与她本人谈了诊断、预后和治疗限度，并请姑息治疗团队参与
text.en: Talked with her about the diagnosis, outlook and limits of treatment, and involved palliative care, before the outcome was known

text.zh-CN: 没有做有害的事：没有在看过进一步影像之前、或未查血常规和凝血就穿刺，没有重复穿刺，没有药物性血栓预防，没有盲目输血浆，也没有转诊肝移植
text.en: Did nothing harmful: no biopsy before the further imaging was read or without the blood count and clotting, no repeat biopsy, no drug prophylaxis, no blind plasma and no transplant referral

text.zh-CN: 解释、知情同意和告知坏消息得当，并确认她已理解
text.en: Explained, sought consent and broke the news well, and checked her understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按 Calgary–Cambridge 的问诊、解释与计划环节，用 SPIKES 告知诊断，并就穿刺做知情同意。良好表现：入院时用开放式问题了解腹胀和恶心，再问她的想法、担心和期望（她怕是不好的病）；穿刺前说明为什么需要取组织、怎么做、主要风险是出血——在已经出过血的富血供肿瘤上风险更高——并用“复述确认”核实她的理解；病理出来后先了解她已经知道什么、想知道多少，给出预告，用通俗的话说出诊断（肝脏血管细胞来源的少见恶性肿瘤），回应情绪，说明不能手术切除或肝移植、治疗能做到什么和做不到什么，谈出血的可能以及一旦发生会怎样处理，并商定包括抢救在内的治疗限度；不作虚假保证，不编造数字。
judgeGuidance.en: Calgary–Cambridge for the history, explanation and planning, SPIKES for the diagnosis and a consent conversation for the biopsy. Good performance: on admission, open questions about the bloating and nausea, then her ideas, concerns and expectations (she fears it is something serious); before the biopsy, why tissue is needed, how it is taken and its main risk — bleeding, higher in a vascular tumour that has already bled — checked by teach-back; after the histology, what she already knows and how much she wants to know, a warning shot, the diagnosis in plain words (a rare cancer arising from the blood-vessel cells of the liver), a response to her emotion, why it cannot be removed or transplanted and what treatment can and cannot do, the possibility of bleeding and what would be done if it happened, and limits of treatment agreed, resuscitation included — without false reassurance or invented numbers.

name.zh-CN: 乔医生（肝病科主治医师）
name.en: Dr Qiao (hepatology attending)

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已经得到的资料提问。入院时：“肝脏质硬、表面不平、有压痛，加上一个月的腹胀——哪些情况都说得通？各自靠什么来想到？”“肿瘤标志物能告诉你什么、不能告诉你什么？”超声之后、穿刺之前：“为什么先做多期增强 CT 或 MRI？”“FDG 摄取衡量的是什么？”“大肿块中心摄取稀疏提示什么，会怎样改变你的计划？”“针进这个肝脏之前你必须知道什么？出血时要有什么准备好？”病理之后：“对这种病，能提供什么、不能提供什么？”“需要请谁参与？”“你打算怎样和她谈？”复盘时按 PEARLS：“她死亡的时间先后说明了什么，又不能说明什么？”可以讲解 ACG 2024、BSG 2020、SIR 2019、《原发性肝癌诊疗指南（2024年版）》、ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS 2021、NICE NG89、ASH 2018 和欧洲肝移植登记（2013）的相关原则，并把原报告的做法与现行做法对照。在学员作答之前不说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例里没有的数据（生命体征、血常规、凝血、肝肾功能、穿刺方式和出血的经过都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher who asks only about what the learner already has. On admission: “A hard, irregular, tender liver and a month of bloating — which processes fit, and what makes you think of each?”; “What can tumour markers tell you, and what can they not?” After the ultrasound and before the biopsy: “Why multiphase CT or MRI first?”; “What does FDG uptake measure?”; “What does low uptake in the centre of a large mass suggest, and how does it change your plan?”; “What must you know before a needle goes into this liver, and what must be ready if it bleeds?” After the histology: “What can and cannot be offered for this disease?”; “Who needs to be involved?”; “How will you talk with her about it?” At the debrief, in PEARLS order: “What does the timing of her death tell you, and what can it not?” Can explain ACG 2024, BSG 2020, SIR 2019, the 2024 Chinese primary liver cancer guideline, ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS 2021, NICE NG89, ASH 2018 and the European Liver Transplant Registry (2013), and contrast them with what the report records. Never names the diagnosis or a keyed option before the learner commits, and never supplies data the case lacks (vital signs, blood count, clotting, liver and renal function, how the biopsy was done and the course of the bleeding are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 兰护士
name.en: Nurse Lan

knowledge.zh-CN: 收她入院的病房护士。用 ISBAR 交班：严淑芳，69岁，近 1 个月反复腹胀伴恶心，收入病房评估；她手上的病历里没有记录入院时的生命体征；请医生来看。病房里有采血管（送检验科）、医嘱和用药记录、护士站的病历；便携超声从影像科推来，CT 和 PET/CT 在影像科，介入放射科打电话联系。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不作诊断。被问到她平时用什么药、有没有抗栓药、过敏、体重或饮酒时，如实说病历里找不到记录。穿刺后按医生的医嘱给她做观察。
knowledge.en: The ward nurse admitting her. ISBAR handover: Yan Shufang, 69, admitted for assessment of a month of recurrent abdominal distension and nausea; the notes she has record no admission observations; please see her. On the ward: blood bottles for the laboratory, the drug chart and the records at the nurses' station; a portable ultrasound comes from imaging, CT and PET/CT are in the imaging department, and interventional radiology is reached by phone. Reads orders back, reports only results that are back, and never interprets or diagnoses. Asked about her usual medicines, blood thinners, allergies, weight or drinking, she says plainly that she cannot find them in the notes. After a biopsy she carries out the observations the doctor orders.

name.zh-CN: 明医生（放射科）
name.en: Dr Ming (radiology)

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学员已经看过的影像：腹部超声（多发不均匀实性肿块；为什么单靠超声不能定性）和 PET/CT（FDG 摄取反映代谢而不是组织学；大肿块中心摄取稀疏提示坏死或出血，这里报告考虑瘤内出血）。建议用多期增强 CT 或 MRI 明确肝占位的性质（ACG 2024），并如实说明本病例没有记录 CT 或 MRI 的结果。不说出肿瘤类型。
knowledge.en: Interprets only imaging the learner has already read: the abdominal ultrasound (multiple heterogeneous solid masses; why ultrasound alone cannot type them) and the PET/CT (FDG uptake reflects metabolism, not histology; low central uptake in a large mass suggests necrosis or haemorrhage — here the report reads intratumoural haemorrhage). Recommends multiphase contrast CT or MRI to characterise liver masses (ACG 2024) and says plainly that no CT or MRI result is recorded for this case. Does not name the tumour type.

name.zh-CN: 温医生（病理科）
name.en: Dr Wen (pathology)

knowledge.zh-CN: 在学员看过病理报告之后才解读：肝右叶穿刺标本的诊断意味着什么；免疫组化（如 CD31、CD34、ERG）可以在同一块组织上补做，不需要再穿刺；本病例没有记录各项免疫组化结果。解释为什么从出血、坏死的中心抽出的标本常常无法诊断。不评论病例中没有的结果。
knowledge.en: Interprets the biopsy report only after the learner has read it: what the diagnosis on the right-lobe sample means; that immunohistochemistry (for example CD31, CD34 and ERG) can be added on the same block without another biopsy; and that no individual immunostain result is recorded for this case. Explains why aspirates from a haemorrhagic or necrotic centre are often non-diagnostic. Does not comment on results the case does not hold.

name.zh-CN: 范医生（介入放射科）
name.en: Dr Fan (interventional radiology)

knowledge.zh-CN: 介入放射科医生。穿刺之前：在知道血小板、INR 和抗栓药情况之后（SIR 2019 列为高出血风险；BSG 2020），影像引导、同轴技术，经正常肝组织穿刺活跃的肿瘤，避开中心出血区和包膜，备血，术后观察；担心出血时可以封堵针道，但 BSG 2020 指出尚无随机试验评估其获益。一旦出血：先复苏，再行急诊血管造影和经导管动脉栓塞。如实说明本病例没有记录穿刺方式和任何出血后的处理；不说出诊断。
knowledge.en: Interventional radiologist. Before a biopsy: once the platelets, INR and antithrombotics are known (SIR 2019: high bleeding risk; BSG 2020), an image-guided coaxial core biopsy through normal liver into viable tumour, away from the haemorrhagic centre and the capsule, with blood grouped and observation afterwards; the tract can be plugged when bleeding is a concern, though BSG 2020 notes that no randomised trial has tested its benefit. If she bleeds: resuscitation first, then urgent angiography and transarterial embolisation. Says plainly that how the biopsy was done and any treatment of bleeding are not recorded for this case, and does not name the diagnosis.

title.zh-CN: 肝内多发占位、组织诊断与出血风险：复盘
title.en: Multiple liver masses, a tissue diagnosis and bleeding risk: debrief

conclusion.zh-CN: 69岁女性，既往无恶性肿瘤病史，反复腹胀伴恶心 1 个月，无发热、皮肤发黄和腹痛；查体肝下缘在剑突下约 5 cm，质硬、表面不光滑、有压痛。超声示肝内多发不均匀实性肿块，最大约 12.0×10.5 cm；CA125 38.10 U/mL、CA19-9 68.60 U/mL 升高，CEA、AFP、CA15-3、CA72-4 正常。18F-FDG PET/CT 示肝内多发不均匀高摄取病灶（SUVmax 7.1），最大约 11.2×10.6×7.9 cm、中心摄取稀疏，考虑恶性肿瘤伴瘤内出血及肝内转移。肝右叶肿物穿刺病理为血管肉瘤（原报告题目称原发性多发性肝血管肉瘤）；数日后她因肝内出血死亡，现有记录不能证明出血由穿刺引起。按现行指南：多期增强 CT/MRI 明确肝占位性质（ACG 2024）；在明确血小板和凝血之后，经多学科讨论行影像引导粗针穿刺，并备血、介入待命（SIR 2019；BSG 2020；《原发性肝癌诊疗指南（2024年版）》）；转介肉瘤专科团队，不做肝移植（欧洲肝移植登记 2013）；预先定好出血预案，并与她本人沟通治疗限度。
conclusion.en: A 69-year-old woman with no history of cancer had a month of recurrent abdominal distension and nausea without fever, jaundice or abdominal pain. Her liver edge was about 5 cm below the xiphoid, and the liver was hard, irregular and tender. Ultrasound showed multiple heterogeneous solid liver masses up to about 12.0 × 10.5 cm; CA125 (38.10 U/mL) and CA19-9 (68.60 U/mL) were raised, while CEA, AFP, CA15-3 and CA72-4 were normal. An 18F-FDG PET/CT showed multiple heterogeneous FDG-avid lesions (SUVmax 7.1), the largest about 11.2 × 10.6 × 7.9 cm with low central uptake, read as a malignant tumour with intratumoural haemorrhage and intrahepatic spread. A needle biopsy of a right-lobe mass showed angiosarcoma — the report's title calls it primary multiple hepatic angiosarcoma — and she died of intrahepatic haemorrhage a few days later; the record does not show that the biopsy caused it. Today: characterise liver masses with multiphase CT or MRI (ACG 2024); take tissue by an image-guided core biopsy planned at a multidisciplinary meeting once platelets and clotting are known, with blood and interventional radiology ready (SIR 2019; BSG 2020; 2024 Chinese primary liver cancer guideline); refer to a sarcoma team and do not offer transplantation (European Liver Transplant Registry 2013); and agree a bleeding plan and limits of treatment with her before they are needed.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 69岁、腹胀恶心一个月、肝脏质硬表面不平且有压痛、下缘达剑突下约 5 cm，应先考虑肝脏被病变浸润；没有发热、黄疸和腹痛，并不意味着是良性。
keyReasoning.en: A hard, irregular, tender liver reaching about 5 cm below the xiphoid in a 69-year-old with a month of recurrent bloating and nausea points to infiltration of the liver until shown otherwise; the absence of fever, jaundice and pain does not make it benign.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 肿瘤标志物既不能确诊也不能排除：AFP 正常不能排除肝脏原发恶性肿瘤，CA125 和 CA19-9 升高也不能定位原发灶。多发不均匀实性肿块需要先做多期增强 CT 或 MRI 和分期，再考虑取材。
keyReasoning.en: Tumour markers neither confirm nor exclude: a normal AFP does not rule out a primary liver malignancy, and raised CA125 and CA19-9 do not locate a primary. Multiple heterogeneous solid masses need multiphase CT or MRI and staging before sampling.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: PET/CT 显示病变代谢活跃（SUVmax 7.1），最大病灶中心摄取稀疏，报告考虑瘤内出血：它支持恶性、提示肿瘤脆弱富血供，但说不出组织学类型。
keyReasoning.en: The PET/CT showed metabolically active disease (SUVmax 7.1), with low uptake in the centre of the largest lesion and haemorrhage read within the tumour: it supports malignancy and warns of a fragile, vascular tumour, but it cannot name the histology.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 组织诊断是必要的，原报告也做了穿刺；安全与否取决于怎样做：影像引导、经正常肝组织穿刺活跃的肿瘤、事先明确血小板和凝血、备血、介入待命、术后观察。
keyReasoning.en: Tissue was needed, and the report's team obtained it; the safety lies in how: image guidance, a route through normal liver into viable tumour, platelets and clotting known first, blood available, interventional radiology ready and observation afterwards.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 确诊多灶性肝血管肉瘤后，根治性切除和肝移植都不是选项；方案是肉瘤专科团队评估下的全身治疗（能耐受时）或最佳支持治疗，同时与她本人商定出血预案和治疗限度。
keyReasoning.en: Once multifocal hepatic angiosarcoma is diagnosed, curative resection and transplantation are off the table; the plan is systemic therapy through a sarcoma team if she is fit, or best supportive care, with a bleeding plan and limits of treatment agreed with her.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 穿刺后数日因肝内出血死亡，不能据记录归咎于穿刺：穿刺之前影像已考虑瘤内出血，这类肿瘤本身也可以自发出血；时间先后本身不等于因果。
keyReasoning.en: Death from intrahepatic haemorrhage a few days after the biopsy cannot be laid at the biopsy's door from the record: the imaging before it already read haemorrhage inside the tumour, and this kind of tumour can bleed on its own; a sequence in time is not a cause.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单篇已发表报告，根据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。数值为原报告的时点记录；不模拟参考区间、生命体征或治疗反应。单个病例不能确立因果，也不能据此把死亡归因于穿刺。
boundaries.en: A single published report, re-authored from the facts version 1.0.0 extracted and not yet checked against the full article. Numbers are the report's time-point values; no reference ranges, vital signs or responses to treatment are simulated. A single case cannot establish causation, and the death cannot be attributed to the biopsy from these data.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征、血常规和血小板、凝血功能（PT/INR、APTT、纤维蛋白原）、肝肾功能和肝炎病毒学都没有记录。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, the blood count and platelet count, clotting (PT/INR, APTT, fibrinogen), liver and renal function and hepatitis serology are not recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 她的用药（包括抗栓药）、过敏、饮酒、职业或其他暴露（如氯乙烯、砷、二氧化钍或放射线）、体重、家族史和体能状态都没有记录。
unknowns.en: Her medicines (including any antithrombotics), allergies, alcohol use, occupational or other exposures (such as vinyl chloride, arsenic, thorium dioxide or radiation), weight, family history and performance status are not recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 穿刺是怎样做的（引导方式、路径、针型、穿刺次数、是否封堵针道）、穿刺前查过什么、穿刺后怎样观察，都没有记录。
unknowns.en: How the biopsy was done (guidance, route, needle, number of passes, any tract plugging), what was checked before it and how she was observed afterwards are not recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 是否做过多期增强 CT 或 MRI、是否发现肝外病变，以及免疫组化的各项结果，都没有记录。
unknowns.en: Whether a multiphase CT or MRI was done, whether disease outside the liver was found and the individual immunohistochemistry results are not recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 致命出血在穿刺和病理报告之后多久开始、如何表现、是否尝试过输血、栓塞或手术、是否做过尸检，都没有记录。
unknowns.en: When the fatal haemorrhage began relative to the biopsy and the histology report, how it presented, whether transfusion, embolisation or surgery was tried and whether an autopsy was done are not recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 她被告知了什么、她自己的意愿，以及是否商定过治疗限度，都没有记录。
unknowns.en: What she was told, what she wished and whether limits of treatment were agreed are not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 先定性，再取材。ACG 2024（局灶性肝病变指南）建议，性质不明的肝占位一律先做多期增强 CT 或 MRI（动脉晚期、门静脉期、延迟期）；《原发性肝癌诊疗指南（2024年版）》对缺乏典型影像学特征的肝占位，通过穿刺取得病理诊断。本病例只记录了超声和 PET/CT，没有多期增强 CT 或 MRI：今天应先做多期增强检查，PET/CT 用于分期和解决疑难问题（ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS 2021）。
teachingPoints.en: Characterise before you sample. ACG 2024 (focal liver lesions) recommends multiphasic contrast-enhanced CT or MRI — late arterial, portal venous and delayed phases — for any liver lesion of uncertain cause, and the 2024 Chinese primary liver cancer guideline turns to biopsy for a liver lesion that lacks typical imaging features. This case records an ultrasound and a PET/CT but no multiphase CT or MRI: today the multiphase study comes first, with PET/CT for staging and problem-solving (ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS 2021).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 肝穿刺是高出血风险操作。SIR 2019：INR ≤ 1.5–1.8、血小板 ≥ 50×10⁹/L（慢性肝病另有阈值）；BSG 2020：局灶病变影像引导，病灶穿刺 INR < 2.0，INR ≤ 2.0 时不输新鲜冰冻血浆纠正，术后至少观察 3 小时，高度怀疑恶性时应考虑延长观察（作者 2020 年修订）；2024 年版中国指南：术前查血小板和出凝血功能，路径经过正常肝组织。本例这些数值一个都没有记录——这本身就是教训。
teachingPoints.en: A liver biopsy is a high-bleeding-risk procedure. SIR 2019: INR ≤ 1.5–1.8 and platelets ≥ 50 × 10⁹/L (other thresholds in chronic liver disease); BSG 2020: image guidance for focal lesions, INR < 2.0 for a lesional biopsy, no FFP to correct an INR ≤ 2.0, and at least 3 hours of observation, longer when malignancy is strongly suspected (as its authors amended it in 2020); the 2024 Chinese guideline: platelets and clotting first and a route through normal liver. None of these values is recorded for this patient — which is itself the lesson.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 肝血管肉瘤会出血。它罕见（不足原发性肝恶性肿瘤的 1%，ACG 2024），起源于血管内皮细胞，质脆，容易自发出血；2016 年韩国多中心研究中，33 例经皮穿刺有 3 例严重出血，没有与穿刺相关的死亡。穿刺仍是确诊的途径——但要有计划，备好血和栓塞。
teachingPoints.en: Hepatic angiosarcoma bleeds. It is rare (under 1 % of primary liver malignancies, ACG 2024), a tumour of blood-vessel cells, fragile and prone to spontaneous haemorrhage; in a Korean multicentre series (2016) severe bleeding followed 3 of 33 percutaneous biopsies, with no biopsy-related deaths. Biopsy is still the route to the diagnosis — but planned, with blood and embolisation ready.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不做肝移植，很少能手术。欧洲肝移植登记（2013）中，肝血管肉瘤移植后平均生存约 7 个月，被视为绝对禁忌；ACG 2024 只在可行时主张切除，并建议转介肉瘤专科中心。多灶病变时，ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS 2021 推荐姑息性全身治疗：蒽环类为标准一线，血管肉瘤也可选紫杉类。
teachingPoints.en: No transplant, and rarely surgery. In the European Liver Transplant Registry (2013) mean survival after transplantation for hepatic angiosarcoma was about 7 months, and the registry calls it an absolute contraindication; ACG 2024 recommends resection only where feasible and referral to a sarcoma centre. For multifocal disease ESMO–EURACAN–GENTURIS 2021 offers palliative systemic therapy: anthracyclines as the standard first line, taxanes an option in angiosarcoma.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 因果与坦诚。穿刺后几天死亡，很容易让人认定是穿刺所致；但本例穿刺前的 PET/CT 已考虑瘤内出血，记录也没有确立死因。对家属和在病例讨论中都要说清楚哪些已知、哪些未知，不归咎、也不虚假安慰。
teachingPoints.en: Causation and candour. A death a few days after a biopsy invites the conclusion that the biopsy caused it; here the PET/CT before the biopsy already read haemorrhage inside the tumour, and the record does not establish the cause. Say what is known and what is not — to the family and in the morbidity review — without blame and without false reassurance.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 出血风险决定其他一切。NICE NG89（2018，2019 更新）要求在药物性血栓预防之前权衡血栓和出血风险，ASH 2018 建议出血风险不可接受时采用机械性预防——本例正是如此；已知会出血的肿瘤需要事先商定的预案（观察、备血、介入放射科），以及按 SPIKES（2000）与她本人坦诚讨论治疗限度。
teachingPoints.en: Bleeding risk shapes everything else. NICE NG89 (2018, updated 2019) weighs VTE against bleeding risk before any drug prophylaxis, and ASH 2018 recommends mechanical prophylaxis when the bleeding risk is unacceptable — as here; and a tumour known to bleed calls for an agreed plan (observation, blood, interventional radiology) and an honest conversation with her about the limits of treatment, using SPIKES (2000).
